snippet.title: My Little Coffee Shop - Trailer
snippet.description:
Welcome to My Little Coffee Shop — a Coffee Shop Simulator ⭐

Have you ever dreamed of opening your own business and successfully managing a small café? In this game, anything is possible!

Try yourself as a restaurant owner! 

Hire staff and waiters, make decisions about the menu, and set prices. But that's not all! You will need to cook food according to recipes and serve visitors, decorate the restaurant in various styles to attract even more customers and earn a profit!

“My Little Coffee Shop” is an amazing combination of genres: restaurant business simulator, cooking, and business strategy.

💰 Manage your restaurant and earn profit

Run the business and manage your restaurant! Welcome visitors to the café, serve desserts, and earn money. Use the money you earn to buy equipment and upgrade the café interior. Just like in real life! Bonus: The staff will handle orders and generate income for the café while you're away!

☕️ Cook food and amaze visitors with recipes 

Love cooking? Pancakes with syrup, aromatic espresso… Sounds tempting! Step by step, discover new recipes (desserts, coffee, and more) that you will prepare for visitors. Take orders and serve guests delicious food and drinks.

🤝 Play together with friends

You can join your friends' cafés and help them grow their business! Cook orders together, decorate the café, exchange recipes, and support your friends in their adventure. Multiplayer makes the experience even more fun and allows you to create a real network of cozy cafés with like-minded players.

👋 Meet like-minded people

Meet other café owners and learn the secrets of their business.

Contact us: pr@entergamestudio.com
